assertions: Before submission, an approved DataForSEO account/Terms record, API credential ref, probe identity, target-content use/data-protection review, available trial credit or balance, duplicate-task protection and disabled auto-recharge are present.

Exactly one standard-priority task is submitted with one establishment keyword, one location code, one language code, depth 20 and newest-first sorting; no raw operator, tag, pingback, postback, callback or retry is accepted.
The task executor suspends and resumes by opaque operation reference for no more than 45 minutes; it never resubmits a pending or ambiguous task and GETs only the exact returned task ID.
The result contains at most 20 reviews, declares complete=false and unconfirmed keyword-based place resolution, and does not infer prevalence from total review count or the bounded sample.

Reviewer name/profile/image, Local Guide status, reviewer review/photo history, provider review ID, images and owner-response text are removed before public output; verbatim review text remains transient and may contain self-disclosed personal data.
Git verification contains no query, place, review text/rating/time/link/observation ID, reviewer field, owner response, operation reference or raw result digest.
Task POST cost and free task GET are reconciled with a hard maximum of USD 0.002; no second task is created for a failed, pending or ambiguous outcome.

Passing evidence remains candidate-only until human admission; supplier access is never represented as Google authorization and durable output is limited to reviewed non-verbatim deidentified paraphrase plus evidence reference.
cleanup: Destroy in-memory verbatim review content and direct review links after the bounded human review window.
Retain only the redacted staging report and billing receipt; do not retain provider task IDs in Git.
